# mondoo_integration_action1 (Resource)

Action1 integration. Scans the Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints of one Action1 organization by delivering the scan through Action1. Requires a Mondoo Platform release with the Action1 integration.

Supply the Action1 API client either as an existing Mondoo credential (`credential_mrn`) or inline (`client_id` and `client_secret`), in which case the resource stores it as a credential in the integration's space and deletes that credential with the integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "action1_client_id" {
  description = "Action1 API client ID"
  type        = string
}

variable "action1_client_secret" {
  description = "Action1 API client secret"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Scan the endpoints of an Action1 organization in the EU region.
# The provider stores the API client as a credential in the space.
resource "mondoo_integration_action1" "example" {
  name            = "Action1 endpoints"
  region          = "eu"
  organization_id = "e5a8b1c2-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
  client_id       = var.action1_client_id
  client_secret   = var.action1_client_secret
}

# Or use an Action1 credential that already exists in the space
resource "mondoo_integration_action1" "existing_credential" {
  name            = "Action1 endpoints (North America)"
  region          = "na"
  organization_id = "0f3c9d7e-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
  credential_mrn  = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/credentials/2Abd08lk860"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `organization_id` (String) The Action1 organization to scan. To scan several organizations, add one integration for each.
- `region` (String) The Action1 region the organization lives in: one of `na`, `na-2`, `eu`, `uk`, `au`. `na` is app.action1.com.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) Action1 API client ID. Requires `client_secret`; conflicts with `credential_mrn`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Action1 API client secret. Requires `client_id`; conflicts with `credential_mrn`.
- `credential_mrn` (String) MRN of an existing Action1 credential in the integration's space. Conflicts with `client_id` and `client_secret`.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If there is no space ID, the provider space is used.

### Read-Only

- `managed_credential_mrn` (String) MRN of the credential the resource created for `client_id` and `client_secret`. Empty when `credential_mrn` is used.
- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
# The API does not return the integration's credential: after the import, set credential_mrn
# to it. With client_id and client_secret instead, the next apply stores them as a new credential.
terraform import mondoo_integration_action1.example "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
